hardware.method: Alternating previous and current selectors with the same 15-file inputs, CPU and AMD, three pairs per backend and cohort. One synthetic and one public-derived cohort with controlled sparse and bitmap edits. Old selector runs from the committed archive and both owners compile the same test fixture. Complete time includes AMD route discovery where applicable, maintenance, compaction, and byte-exact CPU reopen.

earlier_attempts.reason: Baseline configure initially omitted the existing AMD manifest SHA-256 pin.

scope: Two controlled 15-file cohorts with physical Windows AMD execution and independent CPU readback. Complete size compares the same on-volume representation and protective accounting under the previous and current selectors.
